rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of KALLANA, the dwarf elephant reported by Kaani people of the South Indian Western Ghats forests. Native square PNG at least 1024 pixels. Depict a natural mature dwarf elephant, not a calf, not a fantasy monster.
ANATOMY: Exactly ONE natural elephant with ONE head, TWO small narrowed eyes, TWO natural Asian elephant ears, ONE long trunk, FOUR legs and ONE tail. Mature small-stature adult with heavy wrinkled weathered skin, angular adult forehead and dense muscular shoulders, small head relative to heavy body, no infant round head, no soft baby face. Naturally modest Asian ears, both FLARED WIDE in alarmed charge. No tusks, horns, wings, claws or fantasy additions. Natural reduced elephant size obvious beside standard-sized forest plants and rocks; do not depict a giant. [kallana-c01, kallana-c07]
MOMENT: CHARGE directly toward the extremely low camera across a steep rocky high-ground forest trail, head lowered aggressively, both ears spread wide, trunk raised and bent back above the forehead while trumpeting, mouth slightly open beneath trunk. One forefoot drives into loose stones beside camera while other forefoot swings forward; both hindfeet driving off high ground. Body surges forward, not merely walking or stepping downhill. Natural fierce warning charge, tense eyes and forehead, no anthropomorphic expression.
POWER: No documented supernatural power; ordinary loose gravel and wet soil thrown by the charging feet, rain shaken off the raised trunk. Threat through mature animal weight, motion and light only; no visible sound waves, no magical effects. [kallana-c01, kallana-c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle just off the trail, tight three-quarter frontal view, head, raised trunk and flared ears dominate square; all four legs anatomically distinct. Full elephant fits frame. A substantial FOREST BOULDER beside its shoulder nearly reaches its back; normal fern fronds beside rear legs reach its belly and chest, clearly showing dwarf stature. No people or other elephants.
LIGHT & WEATHER: DUSK approaching night, one hard amber side light at horizon rakes its forehead, ears and ridged skin, deep walnut shadows, muted rainy background. Physical droplets and stone fragments, no soft daylight or bright flat front light.
SURFACE: Deep adult elephant skin creases, coarse sparse bristles, mud, rough wet granite and torn forest leaves; tactile weight and muscle, not smooth plastic baby skin.
SETTING: Rainforest of the Western Ghats in Kerala, a rocky trail on higher ground in the Peppara forest range. Wet rocks and dense low undergrowth. [kallana-c01, kallana-c07]
MOOD: Formidable wild adult in a real warning charge, dangerous at close range despite small size. Never cute, docile, relaxed, smiling or decorative. Respect the reported natural animal and its uncertain identity; do not invent supernatural hostility.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs, ears, trunks or tails; no film, game, anime or comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons; no tiny baby face, round infant forehead, oversized sweet eyes or ordinary relaxed walking pose. FOUR natural legs, ONE trunk raised in a charging trumpet and TWO ears flared. No Sri Lankan specific body proportions or height numbers substituted for the Indian report.
depicted_variant: Natural mature dwarf elephant of the Kaani report in a close warning charge, ears flared and trunk raised on rocky high forest ground.

visual_requirements.description: Single natural dwarf elephant of the Kaani reports, mature editorial depiction with one head, two eyes, two Asian ears, one trunk, four legs and one tail; small stature beside ordinary forest boulder and undergrowth.
No documented supernatural powers. Physical charging footfall throws ordinary rocky trail grit; trumpeting pose and charge are editorial action only.
Higher rocky rainforest ground in Kerala Western Ghats/Peppara forest range.

aura: Natural mature dwarf elephant charges with flared ears, raised trunk and weight driving grit from rocky high ground (kallana-c01/c07); no supernatural power.
artistic_choices: Mature depiction, flared ears, lifted trunk and charging moment answer the previous calf-like calm image; these are editorial natural animal action, not a documented hostile disposition.

No Sri Lankan adult measurements or disproportionate dwarfism anatomy from c11/c12/c13 is transplanted into the Kaani report. Small natural stature is grounded only in c01/c07. Tusks omitted because sex is not established.
Low camera, one warm dusk side light, rain, wet texture and moving soil are editorial rendering choices; no aura, visual sound waves or magic.

Normal forest boulder beside shoulder and ferns beside body demonstrate smaller animal stature without giant scaling. Rear legs are partially occluded by charging forelegs and torso in natural frontal perspective.

rejected_attempts.reason: Root reject Sangar2/7: wajah bayi bulat/mata manis/gesture belalai membuatnya lucu gajah bayi biasa walau batu bergerak.

Reads as a gentle, cute elephant calf stepping down a slope, soft face and relaxed ears (GAMBAR §6.1 ordinary animal / cute, §6.4 item 7). Keep natural dwarf-elephant anatomy, but make it an adult animal in a real charge: ears flared wide, trunk raised or curled while trumpeting, head down toward the low camera on rocky high ground, dusk or storm light, with forest undergrowth or a boulder beside it so its small stature reads.

visual_review.notes: Native 1254 inspected. Uji Sangar 1 yes: mature elephant dominates frame; 2 yes: warning charge/raised trunk/ears/skin weight remains formidable at 200px; 3 yes: planted driving forefoot and airborne opposite forefoot, open trumpeting mouth; 4 yes: no supernatural effects, only editorial physical rain/grit; 5 yes: one natural head and trunk, two ears, quadruped body, four anatomical legs with rear partly occluded by front perspective, tail visible at side, no added tusks or fantasy anatomy; 6 yes: no text/frame/watermark/borrowed design; 7 yes: adult weathered animal in charge, not calm calf. Ordinary undergrowth and adjacent boulder give small-stature cues on rocky high forest trail c01/c07.
